title: SARS-CoV-2 RNA Detection in Nasal Mid-Turbinate Swabs
author: Laura Dioni
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1050/v1

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Nasal Swabs
steps.instruction: Collect a nasal mid-turbinate swab according to CDC guidelines and stabilize the sample.

substeps.instruction: Place the nylon swab immediately into a tube containing 3.0 ml Universal Transport Medium System (UTM®).
Vortex the tube in MixMate® at 400 rpm within 3 hours at room temperature.
Discard the swab.
Freeze the Viral Transport Medium at -80 °C until RNA extraction.

steps.title: Isolate Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini kit following the manufacturer's instructions with specific additions.

substeps.instruction: Inactivate 140.0 µL of Viral Transport Medium in 560.0 µL lysis buffer (AVL).
Add 5.0 µL of MS2 Phage RNA (Internal Positive Control IPC) and 5.6 µL carrier RNA-AVE to each sample.
Elute the purified RNA in 50.0 µL.
Immediately store the eluted RNA at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare RT-PCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Multiplex Real Time RT-PCR reaction using the TaqPath™ Covid-19 RT-PCR kit.

substeps.instruction: For each sample, combine 5.0 µL of Viral RNA, 5.0 µL of TaqPath™ 1-Step Multiplex Master Mix (No ROX™) (4X), 1.0 µL of TaqPath™ COVID-19 Assay Multiplex, and 9.0 µL molecular-grade, nuclease-free water (Total volume: 20.0 µL).
Prepare a standard curve by serially diluting 2019-nCoV DNA Control (1 × 10^4 copies/µL) with Control Dilution Buffer at 1/4 fold per dilution.

Distribute 5.0 µL of each standard point into wells with 15.0 µL of reaction mix to achieve concentrations: 6250.00 c/r (ST1), 1562.50 c/r (ST2), 390.62 c/r (ST3), 97.66 c/r (ST4), and 24.41 c/r (ST5).
Prepare a No Template Control (NTC) using 5.0 µL of molecular-grade, nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Plate Setup and Loading
steps.instruction: Set up the high-throughput reaction in a 384-well plate using a Microlab Starlet Robot.

substeps.instruction: Distribute the reaction mix, Viral RNA, ST, and NTC from 96-well plates into a MicroAmp™ Optical 384-Well Plate.
Seal the plate with MicroAmp™ Optical Adhesive Film.
Vortex at 800 rcf in MixMate® for 2 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge at 1200 rcf in a 5804R Centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom.
Load the plate into Quant Studio™ 12K Flex Real-Time PCR Instruments.

steps.title: Run RT-PCR Thermal Cycle
steps.instruction: Execute the RT-PCR run with the passive reference set to 'None' and run type as 'Absolute Quantification'.

substeps.instruction: UNG activation: 2 min at 25°C.
Reverse Transcription: 10 min at 53°C.
Activation: 2 min at 95°C.
Cycling (40 cycles): Denaturation at 95°C for 3 seconds, followed by anneal/extension at 60°C for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Analyze Data and Classify Samples
steps.instruction: Analyze results using Design and Analysis Software 2.4.3.

substeps.instruction: Set baseline start point to 5, baseline stop point to automatic, and fix thresholds based on amplification efficiency.
Verify sample validity: Reaction is only considered if MS2 Ct ≤ 38.
Classify as positive if any two of the three SARS-CoV-2 genes (ORF-1ab, N Protein, S Protein) are positive (Ct ≤ 38).
If only one assay is positive, repeat the test; classify as positive only if the repeat is also positive.
Classify as negative if all three assays are negative (Ct = undetermined).
